uint64_t clk_cnt_diff(uint64_t clk_begin, uint64_t clk_end, uint64_t bit_mask)

Calculate the difference between two clock counts considering a bit mask.

参数:

  • clk_begin -- [in] The starting clock count.

  • clk_end -- [in] The ending clock count.

  • bit_mask -- [in] The bit mask to apply to the clock counts.

返回:

The difference between the two clock counts.

bool clk_cnt_cmp(uint64_t clk_begin, uint64_t clk_end_1, uint64_t clk_end_2, uint64_t bit_mask)

Compare two clock counts considering a third comparison clock count and a bit mask.

参数:

  • clk_begin -- [in] The base clock count.

  • clk_end_1 -- [in] The first clock count to compare.

  • clk_end_2 -- [in] The second clock count to compare.

  • bit_mask -- [in] The bit mask to apply to the clock counts.

返回:

true if clk_end_1 is closer to clk_begin than clk_end_2, false otherwise.
